results.Summary: Nuna Baby Essentials, Inc. (Nuna) is recalling certain Rava child seats with a plastic harness adjuster button, manufactured between July 16, 2016 and October 25, 2023.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of model numbers.  Debris may enter the front harness adjuster and cause the mechanism to fail, resulting in a loose harness.
results.Consequence: In the event of a crash, the front harness may not restrain the child, increasing their risk of injury.
results.Remedy: Nuna will provide owners a remedy kit, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed February 14, 2025.  Owners may contact Nuna customer service at 1-855-686-2891 or via email at info.usa@nunababy.com.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.
